checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
if [ -e "$change" ]; then
  echo "$change is still active - archive it with: openspec archive $change_name --yes, then move it under openspec/changes/archive/YYYY/MM/"
  exit 1
fi
# Measured from the merge base, so an earlier archive of the same name does not count.
base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse HEAD)
targets=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } \
  | grep -E "^openspec/changes/archive/[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-$change_name/proposal\.md$" \
  | sort -u | sed 's|/proposal\.md$||')
count=$(printf '%s' "$targets" | grep -c . || true)
[ "$count" = "1" ] || { echo "expected exactly one new openspec/changes/archive/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD-$change_name/ holding the change's proposal.md, found $count:"; echo "$targets"; exit 1; }

findings.details: expected exactly one new openspec/changes/archive/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD-support-legacy-ios-12-safari/ holding the change's proposal.md, found 0:
